_source: A real, complete 'Hospitality Management Scheme of Work, Form 2, Term 1-3' (a real Zambian secondary school; the source's own teacher name and school name are not reproduced here per this app's standing sourcing policy) was shared with this project via Drive, citing 'Hospitality Management Syllabus 2024' throughout. Genuine gap fill -- this app previously had no Hospitality Management Form 2 content at all. All three terms are this document's own real content, in full, in its own real week order (weeks 1-6, 8-12 each term; week 7 mid-term and week 13 end-of-term test excluded, consistent with this app's standing rule). A real numbering irregularity is preserved as-is, not renumbered: Term 1's own '2.1 Advanced Housekeeping' and '2.1 Cosmetology Advanced' are two distinct real topics that the source itself numbers identically -- kept as two separate topic entries here rather than merged or renumbered. Its own Content/Concept, Learning Activities, Strategies/Methods and Materials/Resources columns are omitted, consistent with the approach used for every other bundled subject in this app.

subject.name: Hospitality Management
subject.description: Hospitality Management syllabus, Form 1-4 (Curriculum Development Centre).

grade.name: Form 2
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 2" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

sub_topics.name: 2.1.1 Advanced Laundry Processes
sub_topics.description: Specialty fabrics, commercial laundry operations, stain removal, fabric treatment, linen inventory management.

sub_topics.name: 2.1.2 Advanced Room Management
sub_topics.description: Deep cleaning, room inspection standards, preventive maintenance, staff supervision, quality control.

sub_topics.name: 2.1.3 Advanced Hair Care

competencies.description: Care of hair and scalp at professional level

sub_topics.description: Professional hair/scalp diagnosis, chemical treatment damage assessment, strengthening and conditioning systems.

sub_topics.name: 2.2.1 Advanced Hair Coloring
sub_topics.description: Colour theory, corrective colour techniques, balayage/highlights/lowlights, colour maintenance, chemical safety.

sub_topics.name: 2.2.2 Face Shape and Analysis
sub_topics.description: Professional face shape classification, facial feature analysis, contouring and highlighting.

sub_topics.name: 2.2.3 Skincare and Treatments
sub_topics.description: Professional skin analysis, chemical peels, acne management, anti-ageing and condition-specific treatments.

sub_topics.name: 2.2.4 Professional Makeup Artistry
sub_topics.description: Foundation selection, eye makeup artistry, contouring/highlighting, special-occasion and corrective makeup.

sub_topics.name: 2.3.1 Advanced Food Preparation
sub_topics.description: Advanced knife techniques, sauce and stock preparation, garde manger, plating and presentation.

sub_topics.name: 2.3.2 Menu Design and Planning
sub_topics.description: Menu types/styles, planning principles, cost analysis and pricing, menu descriptions and design.

sub_topics.name: 2.3.3 Nutrition and Special Diets

competencies.description: Apply nutrition in specialised meal planning

sub_topics.description: Advanced nutritional analysis, therapeutic diets, allergen management, cultural dietary considerations.

sub_topics.name: 2.4.1 Advanced Front Office Operations
sub_topics.description: Guest relationship management, service recovery, premium guest services, technology systems, revenue management basics.

sub_topics.name: 2.5.1 Economic Effects of Hospitality
sub_topics.description: Local economic development, employment creation, foreign exchange earning, infrastructure development, tourism growth.

sub_topics.name: 2.5.2 Industry Analysis
sub_topics.description: Market trends and forecasting, competitive analysis, sector performance, supply and demand, economic indicators.

sub_topics.name: 2.6.1 Guest Interaction Excellence
sub_topics.description: Guest expectation management, cultural sensitivity, communication, problem resolution, loyalty building.

sub_topics.name: 2.6.2 Customer Experience Management
sub_topics.description: Experience design, personalisation, service moments of truth, guest feedback, loyalty programmes.

sub_topics.name: 2.7.1 Communication Skills
sub_topics.description: Written, verbal, non-verbal, technology-based, and cross-cultural communication.

sub_topics.name: 2.7.2 Conflict Resolution
sub_topics.description: Conflict identification, resolution techniques, mediation skills, stakeholder management, negotiation.

sub_topics.name: 2.8.1 Workplace Safety Protocols
sub_topics.description: Safety standards and regulations, risk assessment, incident reporting, emergency procedures, staff training.

sub_topics.name: 2.8.2 Security Operations
sub_topics.description: Access control, guest safety, asset protection, surveillance systems, crisis management.

sub_topics.name: 2.9.1 Business Planning
sub_topics.description: Business concept development, market analysis, financial projections, marketing strategy, operations planning.

sub_topics.name: 2.9.2 Startup Operations
sub_topics.description: Legal structure selection, registration and licensing, initial setup, staffing and training, opening operations.

sub_topics.name: 2.9.3 Business Growth Strategies
sub_topics.description: Growth opportunities, market expansion, diversification, partnership development, sustainability planning.

sub_topics.name: 2.10.1 Nail Care Specialist
sub_topics.description: Nail anatomy and health, manicure/pedicure techniques, nail disorders, nail art, salon protocols.

sub_topics.name: 2.10.2 Barbering Services
sub_topics.description: Hair cutting techniques, shaving and grooming, beard care, fade techniques, client consultation.

sub_topics.name: 2.10.3 Spa Services
sub_topics.description: Massage therapy basics, body treatments, spa protocols, client comfort and safety.

sub_topics.name: 2.11.1 Catering Operations
sub_topics.description: Event planning, menu selection, logistics management, service coordination, quality control.

sub_topics.name: 2.11.2 Beverage Service
sub_topics.description: Wine service and knowledge, cocktail preparation, soft beverage service, pairing recommendations, barista skills.

sub_topics.name: 2.12.1 Hospitality Management Principles
sub_topics.description: Planning and organisation, staff management, operations management, financial management, strategic planning.

sub_topics.name: 2.12.2 Leadership and Motivation
sub_topics.description: Leadership styles, team motivation, change management, decision making, performance management.

sub_topics.name: 2.12.3 Quality and Standards
sub_topics.description: Quality assurance systems, standard operating procedures, guest satisfaction metrics, continuous improvement.

sub_topics.name: 2.13.1 Industry Structure
sub_topics.description: Industry organisation, classification of establishments, stakeholders, supply chain, inter-departmental relationships.

sub_topics.name: 2.13.2 Career Development
sub_topics.description: Career pathways, professional certifications, skill development, networking, industry opportunities.

sub_topics.name: 2.13.3 Industry Trends
sub_topics.description: Technology trends, sustainability initiatives, guest preferences, marketing trends, future outlook.
